title: Where to check exchange rates
question: Where can I check the exchange rate in Israel?
answer: You can check exchange rates through your bank, licensed money changers, or reliable financial websites. Always compare the rate and the fee before exchanging money.

title: Exchange rate and transfer fee
question: Why is the exchange rate different when I send money?
answer: The final amount can change because companies use different exchange rates and also charge transfer fees. Check both the exchange rate and the fee before sending.
